text:
Maria Chen: Kicking off topic + speaker triage for the May 14 webinar — working title: 'Building cost-conscious LLM features'. Thinking a practical workshop + customer story. Panel vs hands-on workshop?
Alex Park: Workshop. 20m talk / 20m hands-on lab / 20m Q&A. Need 2 demo apps we can sandbox. :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: Agreed on workshop. Recommend one customer case study + one infra deep-dive from our side. Target audience = platform engineers at scaleups.
Jonah Lee: Speaker pool idea: Carla (Acme), Samir (BetaHealth), internal: Alex, Maria. Carla said she's available but prefers afternoons.
Samir Patel: I can present a 10-min before/after customer narrative on cost/latency wins and run the lab segment. Happy to keep the lab as a guided repo walk.
Carla Gomez: Confirming May 14 works from my side. I can do a live demo but would record a short fallback clip (30s) in case of live issues.
Maria Chen: Draft run-of-show — please scan and flag changes. I'll drop slides + a rehearsal runbook to the shared folder after this thread.
Maria Chen: ```
0:00 Intro (Maria) - 5m
0:05 Customer story (Carla) - 10m
0:15 Infra deep dive (Alex) - 15m
0:30 Hands-on lab (Samir) - 20m
0:50 Live Q&A + quick poll - 10m
1:00 Close + CTAs (Maria) - 5m
```
Alex Park: Rehearsal date needed — propose May 10, 10:00 AM PT for a 60m full run. @calendar-bot please create the event and include recording test + revert plan.
calendar-bot: Event created: "May 10 10:00 PT — May14 Webinar Rehearsal" — invites sent to attendees. Recording enabled.
Priya Singh: We also need an inbound lead routing form: fields = company size, primary use-case, infra maturity, expected volume. Samir, can you own the form + routing to SDR queue?
Samir Patel: Yep — I'll draft the form and route rules. Will share a preview by EOD Friday.
Maria Chen: Marketing will craft the benchmark narrative slide: baseline vs Redwood Optimize (tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens). Jonah can you run quick medians and post numbers here?
Jonah Lee: On it. I'll run 5 runs (median) on small/medium/large prompts and post results tomorrow morning.
Alex Park: Also small ask — please prep 2 short demo repos: (1) cheap-inference config, (2) fidelity-first config. Samir you lead sample code, Alex + Jonah support infra notes.
Carla Gomez: I'll record a 30s fallback clip and send link to the folder.
Maria Chen: Love it. Next steps: Samir form draft, Jonah bench numbers, calendar + rehearsal confirmed. If no objections, I'll lock run-of-show by EOD. :rocket:
